base_url.description: Beszel's PocketBase base URL, e.g. http://10.77.0.1:8090 (no trailing slash).

system_id.description: The Beszel-internal identifier of the monitored host. Found in the Beszel UI's system detail view (its URL contains the system's record id).

email.description: Beszel admin/user email used for PocketBase auth-with-password.

password.description: secret_ref to the Beszel account password, resolved by the core before the adapter is spawned — never a plaintext value at rest.

lookback_seconds.description: How far back each poll looks when querying system_stats/container_stats records.
